name: Font size and Dynamic Type setting
plain: Reads the system text size setting, which hints at age or low vision.
meaning: Large text settings correlate with age and visual impairment, a sensitive inference the person never chose to share.

android.api_surface: Configuration.fontScale (0.85 to 2.0 typical), Android 14 nonlinear scaling

limits.headline: Can see your text size setting, which may hint at age or vision needs
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the app lays out text
can: Check how large your system text is
Make its own text larger or smaller to match
Use the size as one clue in a device fingerprint
cannot: See why you picked the size
Tell your age or eyesight on its own; the clue is only a hint
limits.differs: Android gives a number such as 0.85 to 2.0. iPhone gives one of 12 size steps.

story.what_it_is: An app sees how large you set your text, which can hint at age or poor eyesight.

marketing.name: Dynamic Type
marketing.pitch: Apple lets people choose text size, and apps scale their text to fit the choice.

marketing.name: Font size setting
marketing.pitch: Android lets you change text size so reading is easier on your own phone.

story.for_you: You pick the text size that is easy on your eyes and apps follow. You never see apps read the setting, but a big font might get you a simpler screen. It might also tell the app something you did not mean to share.
story.for_makers: Makers need this to avoid broken layouts. The setting also correlates with age and low vision, which can lead to guesses about people. Platforms warn against using it to profile.

use_cases.example: A bank app grows its balance and buttons so older users can read them.
A video app makes subtitles bigger when your text size is large.
A news app resizes headlines to fit your text size without breaking.
A chat app grows its bubbles and keeps buttons reachable at huge sizes.
A health app keeps medicine times readable for people with low vision.
An ad tool guesses that a large font means an older person and shows them different ads.

story.android_note: Android apps read the font scale as a number and can respond to it with no prompt.
story.ios_note: iPhone apps read a size category in Dynamic Type and respond to changes live.
